title: Machine Learning
subtitle: ML-based request scoring with an optional adversarial mutation loop. Changes are saved to the runtime configuration and require a service restart.
restart.title: Restart required.
restart.body: One or more settings were saved to the runtime configuration. They apply via a rolling worker restart with no downtime — click Restart in the panel. Manual fallback: {{command}}.
v2.title: Advanced ML scorer
v2.description: 23-feature logistic/GBM scorer. When enabled, it overrides the baseline scorer on every request.
v2.gbmAria: Absolute path to GBM model file
v2.gbmHint: Absolute path to the .gbm model file loaded at startup. Changes require a service restart.
v1.title: Baseline ML scorer
v1.description: Baseline logistic scorer. Runs alongside the advanced scorer when both are enabled; useful as a fallback signal.
adversarial.title: Adversarial mutation loop
adversarial.description: Periodically generates SQLi / XSS / command-injection mutations, tests them against the WAF, and feeds bypasses back to the trainer.
actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Live runtime probes — these do not require a restart.
notes.title: Notes
notes.body: Toggles are written to the runtime configuration and require a service restart to take effect. Check Settings → Runtime info for the current model kind and last-retrain metrics.
toast.settingsSavedRestartDesc: Settings saved to runtime configuration. Restart workers to apply.
toast.gbmSavedRestartDesc: GBM model file saved to runtime configuration. Restart workers to apply.
